## Purpose
`maint_deps.rs`'s `InstallRecord` and `maint_validate.rs`'s `ValidateRecord` are the per-subproject row type inside a maint command's `Vec<Record>` report field — one record per subproject the command iterated, carrying the command it ran, whether it succeeded, and how long it took. This is the maint-family specialisation of the item/report split: the Record IS the per-row Item, and the surrounding `Maint*Report` carries the `dry_run`/`overall` wrapper.

## Convention
Folder: apps/rt/src/commands/maint/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 2
Both exemplars declare `#[derive(Debug, Serialize)] pub(crate) struct <Name>Record { subproject, command, ok, duration_ms }` — the identical four fields in the identical order, letting the two commands read as siblings. Both derive their subproject list from `mustard_core::read_projects(&model)` against grain's `.claude/grain.model.json`, never a hand-maintained list, and both pick the per-project command via a `<verb>_command(kind: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, Vec<&'static str>)>` match on the grain-reported project kind, with stack aliases explicitly listed.

## How to apply
A new maint subcommand that runs a per-subproject action defines its own `<Name>Record` with the same `{subproject, command, ok, duration_ms}` field set (add fields only if the sibling records would benefit too — otherwise keep the four consistent), enumerates subprojects via `mustard_core::read_projects`, and picks its command via a `<verb>_command(kind)` match mirroring `install_command`/`validate_command`'s kind-alias table.
